description: This PHP file implements the EditView for the ACLRoles module in a SuiteCRM project. It handles role editing, duplication, retrieval, and rendering of the view with Smarty templates.

classes.name: ACLRole
classes.description: Represents an Access Control List Role object with methods like getRoleActions.

classes.name: ACLAction
classes.description: Provides static methods such as setupCategoriesMatrix for ACL category management.

methods.name: getRoleActions
methods.description: Retrieves the actions associated with a specific role ID.

methods.name: setupCategoriesMatrix
methods.description: Sets up a categories matrix for ACL actions.
